svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Node position is an algorithm artifact; a matrix has no layout
The two node-link diagrams are the same graph with different random seeds. Nothing about the data changed;
the picture did. Readers nonetheless treat central position as importance and proximity as similarity.
The matrix has no layout to misread: clusters appear as dense blocks and adjacency lookup is exact.
